rci3_hc_age.reason: Individual means, SDs, and ranges for the two healthy control datasets (HCP and REST-meta-MDD) were provided. I calculated the weighted mean and pooled standard deviation. rci4_hc_sex.reason: The number of females was explicitly stated for each dataset. The number of males was inferred by subtracting the number of females from the total N for each dataset. clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa7_association_analysis: Machine learning models (SVM with linear, sigmoid, and RBF kernels) for depression prediction, evaluated by AUC; polar Latent Dirichlet Allocation (pLDA) Bayesian model for identifying latent factors associated with treatment.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Normative modeling revealed individualized patterns of anatomical abnormalities in depressed patients, which improved diagnosis and guided treatment compared to traditional case-control approaches.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa9_key_findings_detailed: Normative modeling demonstrated highly individualized patterns of anatomic abnormalities in depressed patients, with less than 11% extreme deviation overlapping for any regions. Models trained with individual normative probability maps (AUC range, 0.7146-0.7836) showed better performance than models trained with original gray matter volume values (AUC range, 0.6800-0.7036) in predicting depression, validated in an independent external test set. Furthermore, a Bayesian model based on normative probability maps revealed distinct latent brain structural factors related to antidepressant treatment, suggesting personalized treatment response and inclination.

caa10_key_limitations.answer: Normative age modeling was based on cross-sectional data; study focused on patients between 18 and 65 years of age; more subtype samples needed to mine subtype specificity.
caa10_key_limitations.supporting_text: First, current normative age modeling was based on cross-sectional data and should be validated with longitudinal data to make claims about trajectories at an individual level. Second, our study focused on patients between 18 and 65 years of age. ... Finally, more subtype samples can be added to the normative model to mine the subtype speci /uniFB01 city by observing the cluster characteristics of NPM.
